handoff_instructions: PH-T00 done. Added supabase/migrations/0017_app_server_role.sql: a new `app_server` Postgres role (login, noinherit, nosuperuser/nocreatedb/nocreaterole/nobypassrls, owns nothing) that replaces the table-owning connection the app used before. It is granted membership in `authenticated` (so Tx.asUser's `set local role authenticated` still works unchanged) plus explicit select/insert/update/delete + a permissive RLS policy on exactly the tables the service layer's trusted paths touch (ctx.tx.asService / ServiceContext.scoped for non-user actors: org+membership creation, audit_log, business_events, approvals, ops console, webhook/outbound processing, and the rest of the domain tables), and select on auth.users (member email lookups). Tests: packages/core/test/hardening/least-privilege-role.test.ts — role attributes (not superuser/bypassrls/createrole/createdb, owns no tables), app_server cannot create/drop objects or create roles, org/role-based RLS isolation still holds when reached through app_server's login (via `set local session authorization app_server`, which is what makes Tx's `reset role` correctly land back on app_server instead of the test runner's own superuser), and real service code (createJob, recordEvent, writeAudit) still works end to end over that login. Updated docs/PRODUCTION_HARDENING.md (marked the row Done, added the app_server password provisioning step under 'Credentials and decisions only a person can provide') and apps/web/.env.example (DATABASE_URL now documents/uses app_server, not postgres). Ran format:check/lint/typecheck/full pnpm test (root) clean. Note for reviewer: packages/core/test/live-stack.test.ts (opt-in, BO_LIVE_TEST=1, needs local Supabase Docker) still connects as postgres — left untouched since it can't be verified in this environment and seeds fixtures via direct SQL; worth a follow-up if the milestone wants the live check itself to exercise app_server too. Next: PH-T01 "Rate limiting".
